jsonld_raw.name: (500 G) WHITE LOTUS SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

White Lotus | Floral aroma, mainly lotus flower and violet with hints of mandarin and wood creating a warm atmosphere.

Aromatic notes:
Top notes: tangerine, peach, vegetation.
Heart notes: lotus, rose, sambac jasmine.
Base notes: cedar wood, sandalwood, cashmere wood, musk.
